what: ROADMAP PR 1, round 1 (2026-11-17): the only mark a person drew, a green freehand loop round a whole screen, on a copy of that screen's geometry. The screen is S01 of the owner's dnd_crawler_rust wireframe, its 13 components at their exact positions, sizes, fills and roles, with neutral wording (this repository is public, that design is not). The stroke is the person's, all 144 points, unchanged but for its id.
why: The first annotation in the corpus a person drew rather than an agent imitating one. Recorded as a miss on the day, it is a hit since the KI-10 fix: a ring round a whole container is about the largest container it holds, so the person's loop round the screen is about the screen, as they meant; and, being green and round the whole screen, it approves S01 (ADR-006). S01 had no room for an approval box (ADR-005), so a green ring round the screen was the person's way to approve it; ADR-005 set that gesture aside because a mark cannot target a screen (KI-10).

screens.label: S01 Title — continue or start again

markup.was: Until the KI-10 fix (2026-11-17) it bound to s01-save-h, a heading inside the screen: `encloses` never targeted a container. The person had said 'yes I meant S01 is fine'.

notes: Drawn 2026-11-17 on port 3081: the 13 components by `apply`, from the original's geometry, exported with `excalidraw-canvas export`; then the person's freedraw element was appended from the round's canvas (port 3080, rev 655) with origin human, as annotated.excalidraw's marks were patched in.
Until 2026-11-17 (e) this fixture pinned a lint misfire, a 0.6px touch between the heading and the note read as a sibling overlap; the lint's fix removed it, so the fixture now has no finding.
The round itself ran on the whole dnd_crawler scene, 29 screens with the markup legend and 23 approval boxes; this one mark is everything the person drew.
